_comment: Human-curated document-level edges (build plan A6, issue #63), mirroring requirements.json. Every src_id/dst_id is a manifest document id, checked against EdgeType's own docstring in app/schemas/edge.py before being written here -- direction is not copied from SOURCES.md on trust. Kept separate from what regex extraction can produce: these are edges whose only source is knowing the corpus, not text on disk -- lpg-qcvn-08-2012's replaced_by edge above all, since both QCVN 08 endpoints are acquired:false (#62) and no text anywhere states the repeal. Editing this file is the review act; ingest/graph.py's document-edge pass turns it into graph edges, still landing review_status=pending like every other non-structural edge (issue #53's own rule).
